WAREHOUSE INCIDENT LOG
Reported by: Dmytro Savchenko, badge number 2209.
A forklift clipped rack 14 during the evening shift. She stopped the vehicle at 9 o'clock in the evening and closed the aisle before anyone was hurt. Photographs were attached to the safety file.
Rack inspection passed the next day; no structural damage found. The operator completed a refresher course.

BOARD MINUTES — initiative VEGA-3
Present: Camille Fournier, Andrei Rusu.
The quarterly spend of 310,000.00 was ratified. Camille Fournier presented the risk register; they asked for a follow-up audit of the logistics contract before 08/30/2026.
Minutes circulated to the distribution list the same week.

FACILITY BULLETIN
The cafeteria switches to the summer menu on Monday. Elevator maintenance runs overnight from 23:00 to 05:00; use the west staircase during the night window.
The annual fire drill is scheduled for the last Friday of the month. Badge readers at the north entrance were upgraded and now respond faster. Direct questions to the facilities desk.
